maria: Heads-up — for Thursday's RFC review can we reorder a couple authors? Two mid-day conflicts. Quick poll below :calendar:

sam k: Available. Which slots are moving?

maria: Thinking swap slot 3 & 5. Move jin earlier to free up mid-afternoon for infra demos. Also need prereads: @ana and @leo can you confirm your docs are uploaded?

ana: Uploaded my pre-read: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/sharded-cache-preread :eyes:

leo: Not yet — pushing now, should be up within 30m.

jin: Morning works for me. Prefer earlier if possible.

sam k: If we swap, can someone take lead reviewer for slot 5? I'm oncall then.

leo: I can cover lead reviewer for slot 5.

calendar-bot: Updated event order per request. New agenda snippet:
```
09:00 - Slot 1: caching-rfcs (ana)
09:25 - Slot 2: routing-optim (sam k)
09:50 - Slot 3: sharded-cache (jin)  <-- moved earlier
10:15 - Break
10:25 - Slot 4: infra-scaling (maria)
10:50 - Slot 5: observability-primer (leo)  <-- moved later, leo = lead reviewer
11:15 - Open triage / cross-cutting risks (5m per RFC)
```

maria: Also — can we add a 5-min cross-cutting risks item after each RFC? catches infra/security stuff.

jin: sgtm :thumbsup:

ana: works for me.

sam k: I'll take notes for slot 3.

calendar-bot: Preread reminder scheduled: 48h and 2h before. Ping will include links to docs.

maria: Awesome, thanks all. I'll post the final agenda in #eng and bump the calendar invite.
